0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets, 5-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, visit the 3-2 Dallas Mavericks, who are fourth in the Southwest and 7th in the West, in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, which is Houston's sixth of the season. Houston is missing Alperen Sengun (back, soreness), Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
